purpose: Source-backed pre-integration contract baseline, NOT proof of runtime integration

canonicalRules.ids: Backend UUIDs are canonical; demo IDs are not import IDs
canonicalRules.money: Integer minor units and ISO 4217 currency; UI USD decimal display is a presentation adapter only
canonicalRules.inventory: Stock changed only through Inventory API after item creation; product/variant stockOnHand are mirrors
canonicalRules.availability: Display hint only, authoritative stock validated by checkout backend
canonicalRules.auth: Bearer JWT-only; frontend must send Authorization header and manage token lifecycle; no cookie session/BFF is mandated.
canonicalRules.status: Explicit map ACTIVE/DRAFT/ARCHIVED; never silently map ARCHIVED to Draft
canonicalRules.media: Provider-tracked media IDs and ordered gallery; Cloudinary/S3/R2 and VPS disk signer/verify/delete adapters supported; responsive renditions and external CDN purge pending
canonicalRules.pagination: Existing {items,total,page,limit,pages} needs a frontend adapter to ApiPage.pageSize or additive backend alias
canonicalRules.apiStability: Keep /v1 and legacy endpoints stable; add new documented DTOs without breaking already-tested clients
canonicalRules.cart: 04A-2 cart and merge implemented; 04B-1 country/currency live estimated shipping/tax implemented; 04B-2 customer stock holds now implemented (10-minute TTL); address-specific tax and payable checkout/payment remain deferred.

findings.summary: Read-only public catalog now exposes storefront filters and additive stable price/stock/category projection
findings.action: Keep storefront catalog projection separate from admin persistence DTO

findings.summary: Read projection exposes integer minor-unit money and variant effective price; UI decimal conversion remains adapter responsibility
findings.action: Use lossless minor-unit mapping; variant override must be represented; server is authoritative

findings.summary: Canonical backend UUID differs from demo product/variant IDs
findings.action: Resolve explicit mappings; never guess or silently migrate fixtures

findings.summary: Size-only, color-only and combined options share a compatible concept
findings.action: Map options object and variant-level price/availability carefully

findings.summary: Category metadata active, color and sortOrder now persisted; frontend still needs English name adapter and primary-category view
findings.action: Use explicit primary category for existing Admin view while retaining backend multiple categories

findings.summary: Balance ID remains write identity; GET inventory supports productId and variantId lookup for Admin adapter
findings.action: Create stock-adjustment adapter with lookup and UUID idempotency; use server lowStockThreshold

findings.summary: Catalog update DTOs prevent direct stock editing after creation
findings.action: Keep all later adjustments in the inventory ledger

findings.summary: JWT-only decided: Storefront transport currently sends credentials:include without Authorization bearer
findings.action: Adapt frontend API transport to send Bearer JWT and handle refresh securely; no backend cookie session or BFF

findings.summary: Five Admin role keys and persistent permission grants implemented server-side; browser preview still requires API adapter
findings.action: Integrate Admin staff/role UI with /v1/admin/staff and /v1/admin/roles; treat backend policy as authoritative

findings.summary: Backend media assets, verified URLs and ordered gallery APIs now implemented; Admin still needs signed-upload UI workflow and adapter
findings.action: Use canonical media IDs/URLs and signed upload method/headers; Cloudinary POST, S3/R2 presigned PUT and VPS signed raw PUT supported. Responsive renditions and external CDN purge are later increments.

findings.summary: Customer JWT cart and live authoritative price/stock quote implemented; storefront cart adapter is not yet connected
findings.action: Use canonical productId/variantId and Bearer JWT; never send client-side totals or expect inventory to be reserved

findings.summary: Anonymous guest cart capability and transactional JWT customer merge implemented; Storefront local cart still needs API transport adapter
findings.action: Guest browser holds X-Guest-Cart-Token securely, calls PUT /v1/guest-cart/items with canonical IDs and POST /v1/cart/merge after customer JWT login; never reuse token after merge or trust client subtotal

findings.summary: 04B-1 live customer checkout estimate and explicit OWNER country/currency shipping/tax policy implemented; 10-minute stock holds implemented in 04B-2; true address tax, orders, payments and coupons remain planned
findings.action: Integrate customer reservation/release calls with Storefront and add order/payment capture; configure region/postcode taxes and legally applicable shipping/tax rules before production.

findings.summary: Admin Active/Draft cannot represent backend ARCHIVED status
findings.action: Define archive visibility and prevent lossy conversion in Admin mapping

findings.summary: Product and Inventory pages now expose additive pageSize alias with existing limit/pages
findings.action: Use pageSize in Storefront adapter without removing limit compatibility

findings.summary: Both UIs already warn that fixture identities are not authoritative
findings.action: Do not map demos by product names, prices or slugs without reviewed import data
